weekend-german-classes-online: Klarweg offers online German teacher demos for A1–B2. The 20-minute demo costs ₹100 and is advertised for Friday or Sunday after 4 p.m. IST, subject to available slots. Confirm the regular class days with the teacher: a weekend demo does not establish a weekend batch.
one-to-one-german-classes-online: Klarweg lists one-to-one online German teaching at A1–B2, with Hindi and English support. You can choose a teacher and check their ₹100 demo availability. Confirm the teacher’s regular schedule and total course fee before enrolling.
german-classes-for-working-professionals: If your work hours are predictable, reserve a fixed study block and compare available live options. If your roster changes, start with self-paced German and add a teacher session when you can commit to a time. Klarweg has self-paced A1–C2 and teacher-led options at A1–B2.
how-long-to-learn-german-a1: An illustrative 60-hour study plan takes 6 weeks at 10 hours a week, 10 weeks at 6 hours, or 15 weeks at 4 hours. Your calendar depends on what you already know, how much you practise and how independently you can use all four skills.
a1-to-b2-german-course-duration: An illustrative A1-to-B2 budget of 460 study hours takes about 58 study weeks at eight hours weekly or 39 at twelve. These are planning examples. Schedule exam dates, holidays and feedback separately.
german-sentences-for-beginners: Start with four lines you can change today: Ich heiße Asha. Ich wohne in Pune. Ich spreche Hindi. Ich lerne Deutsch. The table below gives 12 phrases with English meanings and Hindi cues.
german-conversation-practice-online: You can practise German conversation here with three ready-to-use A1–B1 role-plays, model lines and a feedback check. Use them with a partner on a call or record both sides yourself.
goethe-a1-mock-test: Try a four-skill A1 mini mock on this page. It includes a listening script, a reading question, a writing prompt, a speaking task and answers. It is original Klarweg practice, not a full official or scored Goethe exam.
german-learning-app-for-beginners: For a beginner, look for German audio, explanations you understand, exercises that make you recall words and feedback you can act on. You can test Klarweg’s browser-based course with the free first chapter before choosing a paid plan.
free-german-course-online: You can try Klarweg’s first chapter at each A1–C2 level free. Start with A1 if you are new. This page also gives you a first-week exercise. Full Klarweg self-paced courses are paid.
oesd-a1-exam-preparation: ÖSD A1 has a written module covering reading, listening and writing and an oral module covering speaking. Use the drills on this page to practise each skill, then use ÖSD’s official material when you want to rehearse its exact format.
testdaf-preparation-course-checklist: A TestDaF prep course should match your exam format, give you academic reading and listening tasks, and provide detailed feedback on writing and recorded speaking. Klarweg offers general German study, so ask a TestDaF provider specifically about exam training.
dsh-exam-preparation: Prepare for the DSH with your target institution’s published rules and samples. Practise turning a source into a short summary and separating its findings from your interpretation. The exercise on this page gives you a starting point.
b2-german-for-nurses: This page gives you a B2-level German handover drill for reporting confirmed details, flagging missing information and assigning a follow-up. Check the relevant authority for recognition, language evidence and any profession-specific exam expectations.
german-for-doctors: Practise the German for clarifying a patient’s timeline and reporting it to a colleague. This page has both versions of the exchange. It is language practice. Check the responsible authority for recognition and any required professional language exam.
german-for-engineering-students: Start with the German for reading measurements, naming deviations and assigning the next lab task. This page gives a measurement scenario, a model response and a second reading to try.
german-for-mba-students: Practise German for MBA cases by stating your recommendation, naming the assumption it depends on and proposing a test. This page provides a fictional case, model response and way to challenge the decision.
german-language-for-jobs-in-germany: The German you need for a job depends on the role and employer. Read the advert for the exact wording, then ask which tasks depend on German and what proof is expected. This page gives sample phrases and an interview drill.
intensive-german-courses-india: Compare the total weekly workload, not just the advertised finish date. Two sample schedules below require 10 or 11 hours weekly including homework. Klarweg lists live teacher options at A1–B2; confirm any intensive timetable directly before committing.
online-german-course-certificate-fees: Klarweg lists self-paced A1 at ₹1,999 for two years and Lifetime A1–C2 at ₹4,999. These are tuition prices. External exams and certificate fees depend on the issuing provider, exam and centre; check that fee separately before buying.
